rationale: TTWO has already gapped up 5.23% on positive GTA VI preorder news and is now trading at 62.9% of its intraday range after pulling back from the $229.46 high, with the last five 1-minute candles showing indecisive chop between $223.61 and $224.82 — no clear directional momentum to exploit. The broad market is under pressure (SPY -0.70%, VIXY +3.19%), which creates headwinds for a long continuation, while the news catalyst is already well-priced in and the stock is well off its high, making a short against a strong fundamental catalyst equally unattractive. With two working orders already consuming buying power and today's realized P&L already negative, the risk/reward for adding a third position in a choppy, post-gap environment does not justify entry.
